critical_issues: Joint and several liability (each student liable for full $3,200 if others don't pay)
If roommate leaves, others must cover their share or find replacement
10-month academic lease may not align with all academic calendars
Furniture damage charged to entire group's deposit
Party size limit (20 guests) could be violated easily
strengths: Early exit option for academic reasons
rationale: Standard student housing lease with typical joint/several liability. Good value for furnished near-campus housing. Main risk is roommate default requiring you to cover their share. Choose roommates carefully.
